unaligned.name: Undeclared
unaligned.summary: Judge each prison by the evidence available.

nordia_destroy.name: Doctrine of Defiance
nordia_destroy.summary: The prisoners are enemies of the gods and must be destroyed before they escape.

zarabia_rebind.name: Covenant of Rebinding
zarabia_rebind.summary: Ancient powers cannot simply be killed; their bonds must be understood and renewed.

helvetica_restore.name: Law of Restoration
helvetica_restore.summary: The seals are divine law and must be restored through correct rite and public authority.

concord_heal.name: Living Accord
concord_heal.summary: The prisons poison the living world and must be transformed rather than merely repaired.

isles_reexamine.name: Witness Doctrine
isles_reexamine.summary: Every sentence must be examined because some prisoners were misnamed or unjustly confined.

dominion_amend.name: Ordered Amendment
dominion_amend.summary: Cosmic order must hold, but an ancient sentence may be amended through lawful knowledge.
